label: winner or champion of
definition: X won competition, race, championship, prize or award Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the earlier winner/champion scope, with Y the event or award, not the defeated opponent. Teams, people and racehorses can win. Participation or finishing alone is not sufficient; a historical win qualifies.

facts.reason: Patriots explicitly win Super Bowl and are called its champions.
All three rows explicitly state Mets winning World Series.
Tabasco Cat is explicitly a Preakness winner and wins it; beginning in an event is broader evidence.
Real Quiet is explicitly winner of Kentucky Derby and wins it; finishing/outrun rows alone would not suffice.
Strange is explicitly United States Open champion/winner and wins it; play and tournament-context rows are mixed.
